policy: Only approved feature claims; no tides; no invented app screens; schedule five per week in Buffer.

posts.text:
Need to estimate your ETA? Astramate helps seafarers and maritime students work through voyage-time and ETA calculations, with clear inputs and visible working. Start with the free core tools on Android.

Explore Astramate: https://www.astralabsph.com/astramate/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=global_android_launch&utm_content=fb_a01
Android available now · iOS coming soon (subject to review).
